description: In inbox.rs handle_create, a Create{Note} activity is accepted and injected into IPFS for any actor that can POST to the inbox endpoint, regardless of whether the actor is a follower of the group. When verify_http_signatures=true this requires a valid HTTP Signature, but the signature check only confirms the sender owns the key; it does not verify the sender is a follower. This means any remote Fediverse actor can inject arbitrary articles into any newsgroup by sending a signed Create{Note} to the inbox. The handler should check ap_state.follower_store.is_follower(group_name, &actor_url) before injecting.
title: ActivityPub inbox handler accepts Create from any actor, not just followers
